movie_title: Climate change: Are there too many people? - 6 Minute English
introduction: What do you think is the biggest cause of climate change? Improve your English vocabulary and listen

vocabulary.definition: the condition of having a population too large to be supported by available resources
vocabulary.example: Overpopulation in urban areas has led to increased pollution and limited access to basic amenities.
